rationale: The Court will likely issue a narrow vacate-and-remand opinion holding that the OCCA applied an unduly demanding prejudice/harmless-error approach instead of Napue/Giglio’s defendant-protective “reasonable likelihood” materiality standard, with cumulative assessment under Kyles. A lone Alito dissent will stress § 1257 restraint and characterize the state court’s decision as a permissible record-bound materiality determination notwithstanding the prosecutor’s concession.
